meaning: 無所不在的；到處可見的
sentences: Smartphones are ubiquitous in modern cities. 智慧型手機在現代城市裡到處可見。
Coffee shops are ubiquitous near the station. 車站附近到處都是咖啡店。

meaning: 高保真無損音訊格式；疑似誤植詞
sentences: I prefer listening to music in ubon flac format for the best sound quality. 我偏好用高保真無損格式聽音樂，音質比較好。
The album is available for download in high-resolution ubon flac. 這張專輯提供高解析度無損格式下載。

meaning: 醜陋；難看；令人不舒服的狀態
sentences: The ugliness of the broken wall bothered the neighbors. 那面破牆的難看樣子讓鄰居很在意。
She saw the ugliness of the argument and left the room. 她看見爭吵難堪的一面，就離開了房間。

meaning: 醜陋的；難看的；令人不舒服的
sentences: The old wall looked ugly after the paint peeled off. 油漆剝落後，那面舊牆看起來很難看。
They had an ugly argument in the kitchen. 他們在廚房裡大吵了一架。
The doctor confirmed that he had fractured his ula in the accident. 醫師確認他在事故中摔斷了尺骨。
The ula is one of the two long bones in the human forearm. 尺骨是人類前臂的兩根長骨之一。
Stress can sometimes lead to the development of a stomach ulcer. 壓力有時會導致胃潰瘍的產生。
The doctor prescribed medication to help heal the ulcer. 醫生開了藥方來幫助治療潰瘍。
The ultimate goal of the project is to promote world peace and cooperation. 該專案的最終目標是促進世界和平與合作。
Hiking to the top of Mount Everest was the ultimate challenge for him. 登上聖母峰之巔對他來說是極限的挑戰。
Ultimately, we decided to stay home. 最後，我們決定待在家裡。
The choice is ultimately yours. 這個選擇歸根究柢是你的。
The boss gave him an ultimatum: finish the report or leave the team. 老闆給他最後通牒：完成報告，否則離開團隊。
She refused to accept his ultimatum. 她拒絕接受他的最後要求。

meaning: 極端的；超過一般程度的
sentences: The runner wore ultra-light shoes for the race. 那名跑者比賽時穿了超輕量跑鞋。
His views are too ultra for most voters. 他的觀點對多數選民來說太極端了。
The clinic uses an ultrasonic cleaner for small tools. 診所用超音波清洗機清潔小工具。
Some animals can hear ultrasonic sounds. 有些動物聽得到超音波聲音。
Wear sunscreen to protect your skin from ultraviolet light. 擦防曬乳可以保護皮膚免受紫外線傷害。
The lamp gives off ultraviolet rays. 這盞燈會發出紫外線。
The doctor carefully cut the umbilical cord after the baby was born. 寶寶出生後，醫生小心地剪斷了臍帶。
The umbilical cord provides essential nutrients to the developing fetus. 臍帶為發育中的胎兒提供必需的營養。

meaning: 不悅；憤怒（尤指因受冒犯而生氣）
sentences: She took umbrage at his rude remark. 她因他無禮的言論而感到不悅。
He seemed to take umbrage when his work was criticized. 他的工作受到批評時，他似乎很生氣。
Do not forget your umbrella; it may rain later. 別忘了帶傘，晚點可能會下雨。
Several small projects sit under one large umbrella. 幾個小專案歸在同一個大架構下。
The umpire called the runner safe. 裁判判定跑者安全上壘。
Both sides asked an umpire to settle the dispute. 雙方請一位仲裁人解決爭議。
I was unable to attend the meeting due to a prior commitment. 由於事先已有約定，我無法參加會議。
The system was unable to process your request at this time. 系統目前無法處理您的請求。
Being late every day is unacceptable. 每天遲到是不可接受的。
The food was cold, and the service was unacceptable. 食物是冷的，服務也讓人無法接受。

meaning: 未受影響的；自然不做作的
sentences: The lower floors were unaffected by the fire. 較低樓層沒有受到火災影響。
Her smile was warm and unaffected. 她的笑容溫暖又自然。
The committee reached a unanimous decision to approve the new project.
There was unanimous agreement among the board members on the policy.
The committee voted unanimously to approve the plan. 委員會一致投票通過這項計畫。
The judges unanimously chose her as the winner. 評審一致選她為得主。
Several questions remained unanswered after the meeting. 會後仍有幾個問題沒有答案。
She had three unanswered calls from her mother. 她有三通媽媽打來的未接來電。
The guard found that the man was unarmed. 警衛發現那名男子沒有武器。
The soldiers entered the village unarmed. 士兵們沒有攜帶武器進入村莊。

meaning: 未參加；無人在場的情況下。
sentences: The meeting went largely unattended, since it took place on Christmas Eve. 由於會議是在平安夜舉行，因此會議基本上無人參加。
System administrators may schedule an unattended installation of the software. 系統管理員可以安排軟體的無人值守安裝。
The old sign made the shop look unattractive. 舊招牌讓這家店看起來不吸引人。
High fees can make an offer unattractive. 高額費用會讓提案變得不吸引人。
This product is unavailable at the moment, but we hope to order more by next week. 該產品目前缺貨，但我們希望在下週之前訂購更多。
A cold, reserved man, he was seen as emotionally unavailable. 他是一個冷漠、矜持的人，被認為在感情上難以相處。
Some delay is unavoidable during heavy rain. 大雨時有些延誤無法避免。
The extra cost was unavoidable. 這筆額外費用無法避免。

meaning: 不知道或不知情；缺乏知識；漫不經心。
sentences: I'm unaware of the answer to that question. 我不知道這個問題的答案。
Luckily, she was unaware that I'd spent the last five years in prison. 幸運的是，她不知道我過去五年是在監獄裡度過的。
The heat in the room was unbearable. 房間裡的熱讓人難以忍受。
The noise became unbearable after midnight. 半夜之後，噪音變得令人受不了。

meaning: 無法擊敗的；非常划算的
sentences: Their team looked unbeatable this year. 他們的隊伍今年看起來無法擊敗。
This store has unbeatable prices on fruit. 這家店的水果價格非常划算。
The team remained unbeaten for ten games. 那支隊伍連續十場未敗。
They followed an unbeaten path through the forest. 他們沿著森林裡少有人走的小路前進。

meaning: 驚人的，驚人的；如此令人驚訝，以至於人們幾乎無法相信。
sentences: The most unbelievable thing happened to me today! 今天讓我最難以置信的事情發生了！
This restaurant makes unbelievable pizza! 這家餐廳製作的披薩令人難以置信！
The room was unbelievably quiet. 房間安靜得令人難以置信。
She finished the work unbelievably fast. 她完成工作的速度快得驚人。
The mother is taking vitamins to ensure the health of her unborn child. 這位母親正在服用維生素以確保腹中胎兒的健康。
The law aims to protect the rights of unborn children. 該法律旨在保護未出生兒童的權利。
The terms of the contract inadvertently left certain unbound aspects to subjective interpretation. 合約條款無意中給主觀解釋留下了某些不受約束的面向。
The hostages' hands were left unbound. 人質的雙手沒有被束縛。
The cup is made from unbreakable plastic. 這個杯子是用打不破的塑膠做成的。
They formed an unbreakable friendship. 他們建立了牢不可破的友誼。
The children showed unbridled excitement at the park. 孩子們在公園裡表現出毫不掩飾的興奮。
Unbridled spending can cause serious debt. 無節制的花費可能造成嚴重債務。
The glass fell but remained unbroken. 玻璃杯掉下來卻沒有破。
They worked for three unbroken hours. 他們連續工作了三個小時。
He has an uncanny memory for names. 他對名字有驚人的記憶力。
The two sisters have an uncanny resemblance. 這對姊妹長得驚人地相像。
The date of the trip is still uncertain. 旅行日期仍不確定。
She felt uncertain about the new job. 她對新工作感到沒有把握。
There is still uncertainty about the meeting time. 會議時間仍然不確定。
The news caused uncertainty among workers. 這則消息讓員工感到疑慮。

meaning: 無可爭議，沒有受到質疑。
sentences: Many of his crazy ideas remained unchallenged. 他的許多瘋狂想法仍然沒有受到挑戰。
The intruders went unchallenged. 入侵者沒有受到挑戰。
My uncle lives in Canada and visits us once a year. 我的叔叔住在加拿大，每年來探望我們一次。
We spent the summer holidays at our uncle's farm in the country. 我們在叔叔位於鄉下的農場度過了暑假。
Do not drink water from an unclean cup. 不要喝不乾淨杯子裡的水。
The kitchen looked unclean after the party. 派對後廚房看起來很髒。
The instructions were unclear, so I asked again. 說明不清楚，所以我又問了一次。
It is unclear why the train stopped. 火車為什麼停下來還不清楚。
These shoes are uncomfortable for long walks. 這雙鞋不適合走遠路，穿起來不舒服。
The question made him uncomfortable. 這個問題讓他感到尷尬。
Snow is uncommon in this warm city. 這座溫暖的城市很少下雪。
She has uncommon patience with young children. 她對小孩有少見的耐心。
The two countries signed an unconditional peace treaty to end the war.
She showed her daughter unconditional love and support throughout her life.
The story is still unconfirmed. 這則消息仍未證實。
We should not share unconfirmed information. 我們不應分享未經證實的資訊。
The two problems are unconnected. 這兩個問題沒有關係。
The printer is unconnected to the computer. 印表機沒有連到電腦。
Charging that much for water is unconscionable. 水賣那麼貴實在不合理。
It was unconscionable to ignore their safety. 忽視他們的安全是違背良心的。
He was unconscious after the fall. 他摔倒後失去意識。
She made an unconscious habit of tapping the table. 她無意識地養成敲桌子的習慣。
The candidate won an uncontested election. 那位候選人在無人競爭的選舉中勝出。
The facts in the case were uncontested. 案中的事實沒有爭議。
The child had an uncontrollable laugh. 那個孩子笑到停不下來。
Strong winds made the fire uncontrollable. 強風讓火勢無法控制。
The investigation managed to uncover evidence of corruption within the government. 調查成功揭露了政府內部的腐敗證據。
Archaeologists uncovered several ancient artifacts during the excavation. 考古學家在挖掘過程中發現（揭露）了幾件古代文物。
The food was left uncovered on the table. 食物沒有蓋好，放在桌上。
The investigation uncovered new evidence. 調查揭露了新的證據。
The jeweler showed us an uncut diamond. 珠寶商給我們看一顆未切割的鑽石。
The uncut version of the film is longer. 這部電影的未刪剪版比較長。
The game is full of undead monsters. 這款遊戲裡到處都是不死怪物。
In the movie, the undead walk through the empty streets. 在電影裡，不死生物走過空蕩蕩的街道。
I am still undecided about dinner. 我晚餐要吃什麼還沒決定。
Many voters were undecided before the debate. 辯論前，許多選民還在猶豫。
The team stayed undefeated all season. 那支隊伍整個賽季都保持不敗。
She is still undefeated in local chess games. 她在本地西洋棋比賽中仍未被擊敗。
The result of division by zero is undefined. 除以零的結果是未定義的。
His role in the project is still undefined. 他在這個專案中的角色仍不明確。
Her talent is undeniable. 她的才華不可否認。
There is undeniable proof that he was there. 有不可否認的證據顯示他當時在場。
The meal was undeniably delicious. 這餐不可否認地很好吃。
He is undeniably good at solving problems. 他解決問題的能力確實很好。
The keys are under the book on the coffee table. 鑰匙在咖啡桌上的書下面。
The temperature dropped significantly under zero last night. 昨晚氣溫降到了零度以下。
The store cannot sell alcohol to underage customers. 商店不能賣酒給未成年顧客。
Underage students need a parent signature. 未成年學生需要家長簽名。
The pilot lowered the undercarriage as the plane approached the runway. 當飛機接近跑道時，飛行員降下了起落架。
The mechanic is inspecting the undercarriage of the car for rust. 技師正在檢查汽車底盤是否有生鏽。
Make sure to pack enough clean underclothes for the trip. 務必為旅行準備足夠的乾淨內衣。
The shop sells a wide variety of comfortable cotton underclothes. 這家店販售各式各樣舒適的棉質內衣。
An undercover officer joined the group. 一名臥底警員加入了那個團體。
The reporter did undercover work at the factory. 那名記者在工廠進行秘密調查。
The new store undercut its rivals with lower prices. 新店用較低價格削弱競爭對手。
His joke undercut the serious mood in the room. 他的玩笑削弱了房間裡嚴肅的氣氛。

meaning: 較不被看好的一方；弱勢參賽者
sentences: Everyone cheered for the underdog in the final game. 決賽時，大家都替較不被看好的一方加油。
The underdog won by one point. 弱勢隊伍以一分之差獲勝。
We should never underestimate the importance of environmental protection.
The manager underestimated the amount of time needed to finish the work.
The company is currently undergoing a major organizational restructuring. 公司目前正經歷一場重大的組織重組。
The patient needs to undergo several tests before the final diagnosis. 病人需要接受（經歷）幾項測試才能做出最後診斷。
She is currently an undergraduate student studying history at university. 她目前是一名在大學攻讀歷史的大學生。
The university offers several scholarships for outstanding undergraduate students. 該大學為優秀的大學部學生提供幾項獎學金。
The miners worked deep in the underground tunnels. 礦工們在深處的地下隧道中工作。
Taking the underground is the fastest way to travel across the city. 搭乘地下鐵是穿越城市最快的方式。
Please underline the key words and phrases in the text while reading. 閱讀時請在文本中的關鍵詞和短語下劃線。
The report helps to underline the importance of environmental protection. 該報告有助於強調（凸顯）環境保護的重要性。
The study aims to identify the underlying causes of the problem. 該研究旨在找出問題的潛在（基礎）原因。
There is an underlying sense of sadness in the beautiful poem. 這首美麗的詩中隱含（潛在）著一種悲傷感。
Lying can eventually undermine the trust and respect in a relationship. 謊言最終會損害（削弱）一段關係中的信任和尊重。
His unusual behavior began to undermine his credibility among his colleagues. 他反常的行為開始削弱他在同事中的公信力。
He found his missing keys underneath the sofa in the living room.
The cat likes to hide underneath the table during the heavy storm.
Many workers felt underpaid. 許多員工覺得薪水過低。
She left because she was underpaid and tired. 她離開是因為薪水太低，而且很累。
The new underpass allows pedestrians to cross the busy street safely.
We walked through the dark underpass to reach the train station.
Trust is the underpinning of a strong friendship. 信任是穩固友誼的基礎。
Workers repaired the underpinning of the old house. 工人修補了老房子的地基支撐。
I wish to underscore the importance of proper formatting. 我想強調正確格式的重要性。
People often underscore when the situation calls for it. 人們經常在情況需要時強調。
Check the underside of the table for screws. 檢查桌子的底面有沒有螺絲。
The leaf has tiny hairs on its underside. 葉子的下側有細小的絨毛。
I don't quite understand what you mean. Could you explain it again? 我不太明白你的意思。你能再解釋一次嗎？
Do you understand the instructions for the assignment? 你明白這項作業的說明嗎？

meaning: 出於容易理解或同情的原因。
sentences: Understandably, he was too embarrassed to speak. 可以理解的是，他不好意思說話。
Embarrassed, he understandably refused to speak. 他感到尷尬，拒絕說話，這是可以理解的。
Her understanding of the problem improved after class. 下課後，她對這個問題的理解加深了。
We reached an understanding about the rent. 我們對租金達成了共識。
Calling the storm bad was an understatement. 說那場暴風雨很糟，其實太輕描淡寫了。
It is an understatement to say she was busy. 說她很忙，實在太保守了。
Understood, I will send the file before five. 明白了，我會在五點前寄出檔案。
The rule was understood by everyone in the group. 小組裡每個人都理解了這項規則。
The company decided to undertake a major research project next year. 公司決定進行（承擔）一項重大的研究專案。
He undertook to finish the work by the end of the week, but he failed. 他答應（承諾）在本週末前完成工作，但沒能做到。
The family met with the undertaker to discuss the funeral arrangements. 家人與殯葬業者見面討論葬禮安排。
An undertaker plays a crucial role in supporting grieving families. 殯葬業者在支持悲傷家庭方面發揮著關鍵作用。

meaning: 在水面下；屬於或關於水面以下的區域。
sentences: Watch out for underwater obstacles. 留意水下障礙物。
He was a pioneer in underwater exploration. 他是水下探索的先驅。
The project is currently underway and is expected to finish soon.
Preparations for the annual festival are already well underway.
You should always pack enough clean underwear for your trip. 妳去旅行時一定要帶夠乾淨的內衣。
She bought some high-quality cotton underwear at the store. 她在店裡買了一些高品質的棉質內衣。
He's so underweight he's had to buy smaller clothes. 他體重太輕，只好買更小的衣服。
He's thirty pounds underweight. 他體重減輕了三十磅。
Many myths describe a dark underworld. 許多神話都描述黑暗的陰間。
The police investigated links to the criminal underworld. 警方調查與黑社會的關聯。
Too much noise is undesirable in a library. 圖書館裡太吵是不受歡迎的。
The medicine may have undesirable side effects. 這種藥可能有不想要的副作用。
It took him several minutes to undo the knot. 他花了幾分鐘才解開繩結。
You can undo your last action with this button. 你可以用這個按鈕撤銷上一個動作。

meaning: 沒有文件記錄的；無合法文件的
sentences: The change was undocumented, so no one understood it. 這項變更沒有文件記錄，所以沒有人看得懂。
The clinic helps undocumented workers get care. 這間診所協助無合法文件的工人就醫。

meaning: 毀滅原因；失敗原因；解開
sentences: His pride became his undoing. 他的驕傲成了他失敗的原因。
The undoing of the knot took several minutes. 解開那個結花了好幾分鐘。

meaning: 未完成的；解開的；垮掉的
sentences: My homework is still undone. 我的作業還沒完成。
One button on his coat was undone. 他外套上有一顆扣子沒扣好。
She is undoubtedly one of the most talented musicians of her generation. 她無疑是她那一代最有才華的音樂家之一。
The new policy will undoubtedly lead to significant social changes. 新政策無疑（確實）會導致重大的社會變革。
The child learned to undress by herself. 那個孩子學會自己脫衣服。
Please undress from the waist up for the exam. 檢查時請脫掉上半身衣物。
Do not put undue pressure on yourself. 不要給自己過度壓力。
The delay caused undue stress for the family. 延誤給那家人造成不必要的壓力。

meaning: 不值得的；以一種沒有保證的方式。
sentences: The speaker unduly criticized his opponent and later apologized for this. 演講者過度批評了他的對手，後來為此道歉。
The team responded unduly to the change. 該團隊對這一變化反應過度。
A feeling of unease kept her awake. 一股不安的感覺讓她睡不著。
There was unease in the room after the announcement. 公告之後，房間裡瀰漫著不安。
I felt a bit uneasy about walking home alone in the dark. 在黑暗中獨自走回家讓我感到有些不安。
An uneasy silence fell over the room after the argument. 爭吵過後，房間裡陷入了一種不自在的沈默。
He has been unemployed for six months and is actively looking for a job. 他已經失業六個月了，目前正積極找工作。
The government provides support for people who are currently unemployed. 政府為目前失業的人提供支援。
The country is currently facing high levels of unemployment among young people. 該國目前正面臨嚴重的年輕人失業問題。
The government is introducing new measures to reduce unemployment and boost growth. 政府正在推行新措施以減少失業（人數）並刺激增長。
The two teams had unequal chances to practice. 兩隊練習機會不平等。
Cut the cake into unequal pieces if you want. 如果你想，可以把蛋糕切成大小不一的塊。
She gave an unequivocal yes. 她給了明確的肯定答覆。
The rules need to be unequivocal. 規則需要清楚明確。

meaning: 以一種毫無疑問的方式；毫無疑問，以明確或明確的方式。
sentences: They strove to make their product unequivocally the best in the industry. 他們努力使自己的產品成為業內最好的產品。
The team responded unequivocally to the change. 團隊對這項變化做出了明確的回應。

meaning: 不道德的；違反職業倫理的
sentences: It is unethical to copy another student's work. 抄襲別人的作業是不道德的。
The company stopped the unethical sales practice. 公司停止了不合倫理的銷售做法。
Be careful on the uneven road. 走在不平坦的路上要小心。
The paint color looks uneven on this wall. 這面牆的油漆顏色看起來不均勻。
The news of her resignation was completely unexpected. 她辭職的消息完全出乎意料。
We received an unexpected visit from an old friend yesterday. 昨天我們收到一位老朋友的意外造訪。
There was an unexplained noise in the hallway. 走廊裡有一個原因不明的聲音。
The bill included an unexplained charge. 帳單裡有一筆未說明的費用。
It is unfair to blame only one person. 只責怪一個人是不公平的。
The rules felt unfair to new players. 這些規則對新玩家來說感覺不公平。
She felt she was treated unfairly. 她覺得自己受到不公平對待。
The small shop was unfairly compared with a large chain. 那家小店被拿來和大型連鎖店比較，並不公平。
He admitted he had been unfaithful. 他承認自己曾經不忠。
The movie is unfaithful to the original book. 這部電影沒有忠於原著。
The city felt unfamiliar at night. 這座城市在夜晚讓人覺得陌生。
Ask for help if a word is unfamiliar. 遇到不熟悉的字就請人幫忙。

meaning: 深不可測的；難以理解的
sentences: Her silence was unfathomable to him. 她的沉默讓他難以理解。
The ocean looked dark and unfathomable. 大海看起來幽深難測。
The team played in unfavorable weather. 那支隊伍在不利的天氣下比賽。
The plan received an unfavorable review. 這個計畫得到不好的評價。
The painting is still unfinished. 這幅畫還沒完成。
Please do not submit unfinished work. 請不要繳交未完成的作業。
The old bridge is unfit for heavy trucks. 這座老橋不適合重型卡車通行。
He felt unfit after months without exercise. 幾個月沒運動後，他覺得身體狀況很差。
The story began to unfold as the main character traveled through Europe. 隨著主角在歐洲旅行，故事開始展開（發展）。
She carefully unfolded the letter and started to read it with excitement. 她小心翼翼地展開信件，興奮地讀了起來。
unforeseen catastrophe 不可預見的災難
unforeseen consequences 不可預見的後果
The trip to the mountains was unforgettable. 那趟山區旅行令人難忘。
She gave an unforgettable performance. 她帶來了一場難忘的演出。
Leaving the child alone was unforgivable. 把孩子單獨留下是不可原諒的。
Forgetting her birthday felt unforgivable to him. 忘記她的生日讓他覺得不可原諒。
The desert is an unforgiving place. 沙漠是個嚴酷的地方。
The teacher was strict but not unforgiving. 那位老師嚴格，但不是不寬容。
It was an unfortunate accident that could have been avoided. 那是一場本可以避免的不幸事故。
It is unfortunate that we couldn't reach an agreement today. 很遺憾我們今天沒能達成協議。

meaning: 因運氣不佳或因某些不幸事件而發生。
sentences: He unfortunately placed his hand on a loose brick. 不幸的是，他的手放在了一塊鬆動的磚頭上。
There were an unfortunately large number of misprints. 不幸的是，有大量印刷錯誤。
The rumor was unfounded. 那個謠言沒有根據。
Her worries proved unfounded. 後來證明她的擔心沒有根據。
He still has unfulfilled dreams of traveling. 他仍有尚未實現的旅行夢。
She felt unfulfilled in her old job. 她在以前的工作中感到不滿足。

meaning: 非常不合理的；不敬神的
sentences: The meeting started at an ungodly hour. 會議在非常不合理的時間開始。
They woke us up at an ungodly hour. 他們在荒唐的時間把我們吵醒。
He sounded ungrateful after receiving the gift. 他收到禮物後聽起來不知感恩。
Do not be ungrateful when someone helps you. 別人在幫你時，不要不知感恩。
She looked very unhappy after hearing the bad news. 聽到壞消息後，她看起來非常不高興。
Living in a noisy neighborhood made him quite unhappy. 住在嘈雜的社區讓他相當不快樂。
Eating too much sugar is unhealthy. 吃太多糖不健康。
The room had an unhealthy smell. 房間裡有一股不健康的氣味。

meaning: 未被聽見的；未受注意的
sentences: Her warning went unheard. 她的警告沒有被聽見。
Many small voices remain unheard in the debate. 許多微小的聲音在辯論中沒有被注意。
His answer was short and unhelpful. 他的回答很短，而且沒有幫助。
It is unhelpful to blame others before solving the problem. 解決問題前先責怪別人並沒有幫助。
The kitchen was in an unholy mess. 廚房亂得一塌糊塗。
They made an unholy amount of noise. 他們製造了非常誇張的噪音。

meaning: 獨角獸；罕見而珍貴的人或物
sentences: The child drew a purple unicorn. 那個孩子畫了一隻紫色獨角獸。
A small company with huge value is sometimes called a unicorn. 估值很高的小公司有時會被稱為獨角獸企業。
The unification of the two small states led to increased stability.
The project aims to promote the unification of the local community.
The students are required to wear their school uniforms every day. 學生被要求每天穿校服。
The police officer was wearing a neat and professional uniform. 警察穿著整潔專業的制服。
A uniformed guard stood by the door. 一名穿制服的警衛站在門邊。
Uniformed students filled the bus stop. 穿制服的學生擠滿了公車站。
The school wants uniformity in the new signs. 學校希望新標示保持一致。
Too much uniformity can make a design boring. 過度一致可能讓設計變得無聊。
The leader tried to unify the different factions within the party. 領袖試圖團結黨內不同的派系。
The program aims to unify the diverse groups through culture and art. 這項計畫旨在透過文化與藝術團結不同的群體。
The manager made a unilateral decision. 經理做了單方面的決定。
They opposed the unilateral change to the contract. 他們反對單方面更改合約。
The company unilaterally changed the contract. 公司單方面更改了合約。
He should not make this decision unilaterally. 他不該單方面做這個決定。
The damage after the storm was unimaginable. 暴風雨後的損害難以想像。
Life without clean water is unimaginable to many people. 對許多人來說，沒有乾淨水源的生活難以想像。
Do not worry about that unimportant detail. 不要擔心那個不重要的細節。
The color of the folder is unimportant. 資料夾的顏色並不重要。
The rules are confusing to the uninitiated. 這些規則對不了解的人來說很混亂。
For the uninitiated, this game looks simple. 對初學者來說，這個遊戲看起來很簡單。
He seemed uninterested in the movie. 他似乎對這部電影不感興趣。
The cat was uninterested in the new toy. 那隻貓對新玩具不感興趣。
The lecture was long and uninteresting. 那場演講又長又無趣。
The book became uninteresting after the first chapter. 這本書第一章之後變得很乏味。
The workers decided to form a trade union to protect rights. 工人們決定成立工會（聯盟）以保護權利。
The European Union is an international organization of countries. 歐盟是一個由多國組組成織的國際組織。

meaning: 工會主義者；支持聯合的人
sentences: The unionist spoke for the workers at the meeting. 那位工會主義者在會議上替工人發聲。
She became a unionist after seeing unfair pay. 她看到不公平薪資後成為工會支持者。
Every individual has their own unique talents and gifts. 每個個體都擁有自己獨特的才華與天賦。
The city center is a fascinating blend of unique architecture. 市中心是獨特建築的迷人融合。
a uniquely gifted musician 一位具有獨特天賦的音樂家
components that are uniquely numbered for identification 具有唯一編號以便識別的組件
The children answered in unison. 孩子們齊聲回答。
The team moved in unison during the dance. 那支隊伍跳舞時動作一致。
Each unit in the book has two short lessons. 這本書每個單元有兩篇短課文。
The apartment building has twenty units. 這棟公寓大樓有二十戶。

meaning: 一位論派的；主張統一的
sentences: The church follows a Unitarian tradition. 這間教會遵循一位論傳統。
He took a unitarian view of the system. 他用統一的觀點看待這個系統。

meaning: 將權力集中在一個機構，而不是與更多地方機構分享。
sentences: a unitary authority 單一權力機構
a unitary state 單一制國家
We must unite to solve the serious environmental problems. 我們必須團結起來解決嚴重的環境問題。
The project managed to unite the entire local community together. 這個專案竟然將整個當地社區團結在了一起。

meaning: 涉及多個主體的聯合活動。
sentences: The two parties stood united against the proposal. 兩黨一致反對這項提議。
A united effort is needed to solve the problem. 解決問題需要團結一致。
National unity is essential for the prosperity of the country. 國家統一（團結）對於國家的繁榮至關重要。
The festival celebrated the unity and diversity of the culture. 節日慶祝了文化的團結與多樣性。

meaning: 普遍的、全宇宙的、通用的
sentences: The need for love and belonging is a universal human experience. 對愛和歸屬感的渴望是人類普遍的經歷。
Music is often called a universal language because it can be understood by everyone. 音樂常被稱為通用的語言，因為每個人都能理解它。
The song is almost universally loved. 這首歌幾乎普遍受到喜愛。
Good manners are universally useful. 好禮貌到哪裡都很有用。
The universe is full of stars and planets. 宇宙中充滿星星和行星。
In her story, the hero lives in a different universe. 在她的故事裡，主角住在另一個宇宙。
My sister studies biology at university. 我姐姐在大學讀生物。
The university library stays open late. 大學圖書館開到很晚。
The punishment was unjust. 這項懲罰不公平。
They protested against the unjust rule. 他們抗議那項不公正的規定。
The price increase was unjustified. 這次漲價沒有正當理由。
She felt the criticism was unjustified. 她覺得這項批評沒有道理。
He unknowingly took the wrong bag. 他不知情地拿錯了包包。
She unknowingly shared an old address. 她無意中分享了一個舊地址。
The cause of the fire remains unknown. 火災原因仍然未知。
The singer was unknown before this song became popular. 這首歌走紅前，那位歌手並不出名。
Parking here is unlawful. 在這裡停車是違法的。
The company denied any unlawful action. 公司否認有任何違法行為。
The files were unlawfully copied. 這些檔案被違法複製。
He was accused of entering the building unlawfully. 他被指控違法進入大樓。

meaning: 擺脫皮帶，或像皮帶一樣。
sentences: He unleashed his dog in the park. 他在公園裡放出了他的狗。
To unleash means to free from a leash, or as from a leash. 釋放意味著擺脫束縛，或擺脫束縛。
We will go hiking unless it rains. 除非下雨，否則我們會去健行。
Do not open the door unless you know who is outside. 除非你知道外面是誰，否則不要開門。
Unlike his brother, he enjoys cooking. 和哥哥不同，他喜歡做菜。
This winter is unlike last year. 今年冬天和去年不一樣。
It is unlikely that the weather will improve by tomorrow. 天氣在明天之前不太可能好轉。
He is an unlikely candidate for the position, but he might win. 他不是那個職位的熱門人選，但他可能會贏。

meaning: 發洩或表達；卸下自己的負擔。
sentences: to unload on someone 向某人傾訴
To unload means to give vent to or express; to unburden oneself of. 卸是指發洩或表達；卸下自己的負擔。
I've forgotten my password and can't unlock my smartphone. 我忘了密碼，無法解鎖我的手機。
The project aims to unlock the potential of new technologies for education. 該專案旨在開啟（釋放）新技術在教育領域的潛力。
The back door was unlocked. 後門沒有上鎖。
Keep your phone unlocked for a moment. 先讓手機保持解鎖一下。
I was unlucky and missed the last train. 我很倒楣，錯過了末班車。
It was an unlucky day for our team. 那天對我們隊來說很不幸。
The drone is an unmanned aircraft. 無人機是一種無人操作的飛行器。
The station is unmanned at night. 這個車站夜間無人值守。
The package arrived in an unmarked box. 包裹裝在沒有標記的盒子裡送到。
They parked beside an unmarked car. 他們停在一輛沒有標誌的車旁。
An unnamed witness called the police. 一位未具名的目擊者報警。
The small road was unnamed on the map. 地圖上沒有標出那條小路的名字。
His smile looked unnatural in the photo. 他在照片裡的笑容看起來不自然。
The bright green color seemed unnatural for the soup. 湯呈現亮綠色，看起來很反常。

meaning: 以不必要的方式；不是出於必然。
sentences: He unnecessarily repeated much of what others had covered. 他不必要地重複了其他人已經報道過的大部分內容。
The team responded unnecessarily to the change. 團隊對這項變化做出了不必要的反應。
Do not make unnecessary noise at night. 晚上不要製造不必要的噪音。
The extra meeting was unnecessary. 那場額外會議沒有必要。

meaning: 非正式的；未經官方認可的
sentences: This is only an unofficial result. 這只是非正式結果。
They held an unofficial meeting after work. 他們下班後開了一場非正式會議。
His desk was messy and unorganized. 他的書桌又亂又沒整理。
The event felt unorganized at the beginning. 活動一開始讓人覺得沒有組織。
Her unorthodox teaching style kept students awake. 她非傳統的教學方式讓學生保持清醒。
The chef used an unorthodox method to cook the fish. 那位廚師用不尋常的方法料理魚。

meaning: 從包裝或容器中取出，特別是對於先前已緊密且牢固地排列在包裝中的物品。
sentences: They didn't have time to unpack their bags before going out to dinner. 他們在出去吃晚餐之前沒有時間打開行李。
To unpack means to remove from a package or container, particularly with respect to items that had previously been arranged closely and securely in a pack. 打開包裝是指從包裝或容器中取出，特別是對於先前緊密且牢固地排列在包裝中的物品。

meaning: 已拆開的；未整理進箱的
sentences: The suitcase sat unpacked by the bed. 行李箱放在床邊，還沒整理。
The gifts were unpacked after dinner. 晚餐後，禮物被拆開了。
There are two unpaid bills on the table. 桌上有兩張未付款的帳單。
She took an unpaid internship during the summer. 她暑假做了一份無薪實習。
Her knowledge of the city is unparalleled. 她對這座城市的了解無人能比。
The view from the mountain was unparalleled. 山上的景色無與倫比。

meaning: 斷開電源，尤其是電源插座。
sentences: To save electricity, I unplug my computer when I am not at home. 為了省電費，我不在家時會拔掉電腦電源。
People often unplug when the situation calls for it. 當情況需要時，人們常常會拔掉插頭。
The lamp was unplugged, so it did not turn on. 檯燈沒有插電，所以沒有亮。
The band played an unplugged show. 那個樂團演出了一場原音演唱會。
The new rule was unpopular with students. 新規定不受學生歡迎。
He made an unpopular decision. 他做了一個不受歡迎的決定。
The country experienced an unprecedented economic boom during the late 1990s. 該國在 1990 年代末經歷了空前的經濟繁榮。
The new policy is an unprecedented step towards protecting environmental rights. 新政策是保護環境權利方面邁出的史無前例的一步。
I felt unprepared for the test. 我覺得自己還沒準備好考試。
The town was unprepared for the flood. 這個城鎮對洪水沒有準備。

meaning: 沒有效率的；沒有成果的
sentences: The long meeting was unproductive. 那場冗長的會議沒有成果。
Checking messages all morning can be unproductive. 整個早上都在看訊息可能很沒效率。

meaning: 無利可圖的；沒有收益的
sentences: The shop closed because it was unprofitable. 那家店因為無利可圖而關門。
The project became unprofitable after costs rose. 成本上升後，這個專案變得沒有收益。
The bike was left unprotected in the rain. 那台腳踏車沒遮沒擋地放在雨中。
Unprotected skin can burn quickly in strong sun. 沒有防護的皮膚在烈日下很快會曬傷。
He attacked me, suddenly, unprovoked. 他突然無緣無故攻擊我。
The team responded unprovoked to the change. 團隊無緣無故地對這一變化做出了反應。
He is unqualified for the job. 他不符合這份工作的資格。
She gave the plan her unqualified support. 她毫無保留地支持這個計畫。

meaning: 使（某事）不再混亂或糾纏；解開，解開。
sentences: Mother couldn’t unravel the ball of wool after the cat had played with it. 貓玩過毛線球後，媽媽就無法將它解開。
Stop playing with the seam of the tablecloth! You’ll unravel it. 別再玩桌布的接縫了！你會解開它的。

meaning: 非常令人印象深刻；驚人的;難以置信;極好的;比現實生活中的典型情況更大或更奇妙。
sentences: The video includes unreal footage of an eight-metre wave. 影片包括八米波浪的虛幻鏡頭。
I just had an unreal hamburger. 我剛剛吃了一個不真實的漢堡。
His demands were unreasonable. 他的要求不合理。
It is unreasonable to expect perfect results immediately. 期待立刻有完美結果是不合理的。
The team was given an unreasonably short amount of time to put together a presentation. 團隊被給予了非常短的時間來整理簡報。
The team responded unreasonably to the change. 團隊對這項變化的反應不合理。
The holiday started with two unrelated mishaps. 這個假期始於兩起無關的事故。

I was having lunch with Jim the other day, who's just had his first kid. Oh, and on a completely unrelated note, there's a new cinema opened up in town. 有一天我和吉姆一起吃午飯，他剛剛有了他的第一個孩子。哦，還有一個完全不相關的話題，鎮上新開了一家電影院。
The old bus is unreliable in cold weather. 這輛舊公車在冷天很不可靠。
Do not use unreliable information in your report. 不要在報告中使用不可靠的資訊。
The issue remains unresolved. 這個問題仍未解決。
They argued about unresolved family matters. 他們為尚未解決的家庭問題爭吵。
The city faced unrest after the election. 選舉後，這座城市出現動盪。
Workers expressed unrest over the new rules. 員工對新規定表達不滿與不安。
The crowd showed unrestrained joy. 群眾表現出毫不克制的喜悅。
Unrestrained spending hurt the budget. 不受控制的花費傷害了預算。
The teacher calmed the unruly class. 老師讓難管的班級安靜下來。
His unruly hair would not stay flat. 他亂翹的頭髮怎麼也壓不平。
The bridge is unsafe after the storm. 暴風雨後，這座橋不安全。
It is unsafe to text while driving. 開車時傳訊息是不安全的。
She escaped the accident unscathed. 她在事故中毫髮無傷地逃過一劫。
The old tree survived the storm unscathed. 那棵老樹在暴風雨中毫無損傷。
The ladder was unsecured and could fall. 梯子沒有固定，可能會倒。
He applied for an unsecured loan. 他申請了一筆無擔保貸款。
The damage remained unseen until we moved the sofa. 直到我們移開沙發，才看見損壞。
Unseen workers keep the building clean. 看不見的工作人員讓大樓保持乾淨。
The empty hallway felt unsettling at night. 夜裡空蕩蕩的走廊讓人不安。
She heard an unsettling noise outside the window. 她聽到窗外傳來令人不安的聲音。
The contract is still unsigned. 合約還沒有簽名。
The note was unsigned. 那張字條沒有署名。

meaning: 未經要求的；主動提供的
sentences: She received an unsolicited email. 她收到一封未經要求寄來的信。
He gave unsolicited advice at dinner. 他晚餐時主動給了別人沒要求的建議。

meaning: 難以形容的；說不出口的
sentences: The family suffered unspeakable pain. 那家人承受了難以形容的痛苦。
The room was in an unspeakable mess. 房間亂到難以形容。

meaning: 未說出口的；心照不宣的
sentences: There was an unspoken agreement between them. 他們之間有一種心照不宣的默契。
Her smile carried an unspoken message. 她的笑容帶著未說出口的訊息。
politically unstable 政治不穩定
The political situation remains unstable. 政治局勢仍然不穩定。
The old chair was unsteady. 那張舊椅子不穩。
He felt unsteady after standing up too fast. 他站得太快，覺得有點不穩。
The team felt unstoppable after three wins. 三連勝後，那支隊伍覺得勢不可擋。
The water became an unstoppable force. 水流變成無法阻擋的力量。
Their first attempt was unsuccessful. 他們第一次嘗試失敗了。
She was unsuccessful in finding her lost ring. 她沒能找到遺失的戒指。
Nurses are often unsung heroes. 護士常是被忽略的英雄。
He thanked the unsung workers behind the event. 他感謝活動幕後那些未受讚揚的工作人員。
Children should not swim unsupervised. 小孩不應在無人監督下游泳。
The machine cannot run unsupervised overnight. 這台機器不能整晚無人看管地運轉。

meaning: 不受支持的；沒有支撐的
sentences: The claim is unsupported by evidence. 這項說法沒有證據支持。
Do not stand on an unsupported board. 不要站在沒有支撐的木板上。
I am unsure about the answer. 我不確定答案。
She sounded unsure on the phone. 她在電話裡聽起來沒有把握。
The scam targeted unsuspecting shoppers. 這場詐騙鎖定毫無戒心的購物者。
He surprised an unsuspecting friend with a cake. 他拿蛋糕給毫無防備的朋友一個驚喜。

meaning: 站不住腳的；無法維持的
sentences: His excuse became untenable after the video appeared. 影片出現後，他的藉口就站不住腳了。
The rent was so high that the situation became untenable. 房租太高，情況變得無法維持。

meaning: 難以想像的；不可思議的
sentences: Losing the old family photos was unthinkable to her. 對她來說，失去那些老家庭照片難以想像。
A snowstorm in summer seems unthinkable here. 在這裡，夏天出現暴風雪似乎不可思議。
Please wait here until I come back from the meeting. 請在這裡等我開會回來。
I'll be busy until the end of this month. 我會一直忙到這個月底。
His untimely joke made everyone quiet. 他不合時宜的玩笑讓大家安靜下來。
The frost caused the flowers to make an untimely end. 霜害讓花朵過早凋謝。

meaning: 直至達到以下程度或時間；直到。
sentences: Unto This Last (John Ruskin) 到最後（約翰·羅斯金）
The word unto is used to connect ideas in a sentence. to 這個字用來連結句子中的想法。
The old house held untold stories. 那棟老房子藏著許多未說出的故事。
The flood caused untold damage. 洪水造成難以估計的損害。
In that office, the director seemed untouchable. 在那間辦公室裡，主管似乎無人能動。
The record once looked untouchable. 那項紀錄曾經看起來無法挑戰。
The cake was left untouched on the table. 蛋糕放在桌上，沒有人碰。
The village remained untouched by the storm. 那個村莊沒有受到暴風雨影響。
The rumor is completely untrue. 這個謠言完全不是真的。
It is untrue that she quit her job. 她辭職的說法並不是真的。
There are unused notebooks in the drawer. 抽屜裡有沒用過的筆記本。
He was unused to waking up early. 他不習慣早起。
Every once in a while, though, Idol comes across an unusual talent who just blows everyone away. 不過，每隔一段時間，《偶像》就會遇到一位不尋常的天才，讓所有人驚嘆不已。
It’s definitely not unusual for a couple to meet through friends or be set up on a date. 情侶透過朋友認識或安排約會絕對不是什麼罕見的事情。
It is unusually cold today. 今天異常地冷。
She was unusually quiet at dinner. 她晚餐時安靜得不尋常。
The famous architect is planning to unveil his new building design soon.
The government decided to unveil the new economic policy early today.

meaning: 笨重難操作的；難以控制或處理的。
sentences: The box was too unwieldy for one person to carry upstairs. 那個箱子太笨重，一個人很難搬上樓。
As the company grew, its old filing system became unwieldy. 隨著公司擴大，舊的歸檔系統變得難以管理。
He was unwilling to apologize. 他不願意道歉。
The child was unwilling to share the toy. 那個孩子不願意分享玩具。

meaning: 放鬆；放鬆；休息並緩解壓力。
sentences: After work, I like to unwind by smoking a pipe while reading the paper. 下班後，我喜歡一邊讀報紙一邊抽煙鬥來放鬆。
To unwind means to relax; to chill out; to rest and become relieved of stress. 放鬆意味著放鬆；放鬆一下；休息並緩解壓力。
unwise kings 不明智的國王
unwise measures 不明智的措施

meaning: 以一種不經意的方式；不經意地、不經意地、無意地、不知不覺地。
sentences: She realized to her horror that she had unwittingly helped those people she most despised. 她驚恐地意識到，自己無意間幫助了那些她最鄙視的人。
The team responded unwittingly to the change. 團隊不知不覺地對這項變化做出了反應。
Do not feel unworthy of help. 不要覺得自己不值得被幫助。
The broken chair was unworthy of repair. 那張破椅子不值得修了。
Every family has unwritten rules. 每個家庭都有不成文的規矩。
The agreement was unwritten but clear. 這項協議沒有寫下來，但很清楚。
He looked up at the stars in the clear night sky. 他仰望晴朗夜空中的星星。
I usually wake up at 7:00 a.m. every day. 我通常每天早上七點起床。
She sounded upbeat after the interview. 面試後，她聽起來很樂觀。
The song has an upbeat rhythm. 這首歌節奏輕快。

meaning: 在相對不久的將來發生或出現。
sentences: We are ready for whatever is upcoming. 我們已準備好應對即將發生的一切。
The Federal budget lays out government spending for the upcoming budget year. 聯邦預算列出了即將到來的預算年度的政府支出。
Please make sure you update your software regularly to ensure security. 請務必定期更新您的軟體以確保安全。
The manager provided an update on the progress of the new project. 經理提供了新專案進展的最新（更新）情況。
The airline decided to upgrade her ticket to business class for free. 航空公司決定將她的機票免費升等（升級）到商務艙。
We need to upgrade our existing computer systems to improve efficiency. 我們需要升級現有的電腦系統以提高效率。
We walked uphill for twenty minutes. 我們往上坡走了二十分鐘。
Starting a small business can feel like an uphill battle. 創業有時會像一場艱難的戰鬥。
To uphold means to hold up; to lift on high; to elevate. 堅持是堅持；舉到高處；提升。
People may uphold in different situations depending on the context. 人們可能會根據具體情況在不同的情況下堅持。
We decided to upholster the old armchair with new fabric. 我們決定用新布料重新裝飾那張舊扶手椅。
It takes skill to upholster a sofa properly. 正確地為沙發裝上墊子和飾面需要技巧。
The upkeep of an old house can be expensive. 老房子的維護費可能很高。
Regular upkeep keeps the garden beautiful. 定期保養能讓花園保持美麗。
To uplift means to pick up; take possession of. 舉起的意思是拿起；擁有.
People may uplift in different situations depending on the context. 根據具體情況，人們可能會在不同的情況下感到振奮。

meaning: 令人振奮的；鼓舞人心的
sentences: The song has an uplifting chorus. 這首歌的副歌很振奮人心。
Her message was simple and uplifting. 她的訊息簡單又鼓舞人心。
Please upload the finished report before noon. 請在中午前上傳完成的報告。
It took a few minutes to upload the video. 上傳影片花了幾分鐘。
Once upon a time, there lived a beautiful princess in a castle. 從前，有一位美麗的公主住在城堡裡。
The decision was based upon the latest scientific evidence available. 該決定是基於目前可獲得的最新科學證據。
The bedrooms are located on the upper floor of the new house. 臥室位於新房子的上層樓層。
She has experienced a lot of pain in her upper back lately. 她最近上背部一直感到很疼痛。
The old grandfather clock stood upright against the wooden wall.
He is a very upright man who always does the right and honest thing.
The government managed to put down the violent military uprising quickly.
The book explores the causes of the popular uprising in the city center.
The announcement caused an uproar in the office. 這項公告在辦公室引起一陣騷動。
There was an uproar when the concert was canceled. 演唱會取消時，現場一片嘩然。
They had dinner at an upscale restaurant. 他們在一家高級餐廳吃晚餐。
The neighborhood has many upscale shops. 這個街區有許多高價位商店。
She was very upset when she heard the news about the accident. 聽到事故的消息時，她感到非常難過。
I'm sorry, I didn't mean to upset you with my earlier comment. 對不起，我不是故意要用剛才的話讓妳不開心的。

meaning: 令人心煩的；令人不安的
sentences: The news was upsetting for the whole family. 這則消息讓全家人都很難過。
It was upsetting to see the broken window. 看到破掉的窗戶讓人心煩。
The upside of working from home is saving travel time. 在家工作的好處是省下通勤時間。
Place the box with the upside facing up. 把盒子的上側朝上放。
The guest bedroom and bathroom are located upstairs. 客房和浴室位於樓上。
He ran upstairs to get his laptop and then came back down. 他跑上樓拿筆電，然後又下來了。
They moved to an upstate town. 他們搬到州北部的一個小鎮。
The upstate area gets more snow. 州北部地區下雪更多。

meaning: 比其他事情發生得更早；對其他事物有影響；造成其他事情的後果。
sentences: Input entry is upstream of input validation in the runtime process. 輸入條目是運行時進程中輸入驗證的上游。
The outage was caused by an upstream error in a payments library. 此次中斷是由支付庫中的上游錯誤引起的。
Plants need water uptake to grow well. 植物需要吸收水分才能好好生長。
The uptake of the new app was slow at first. 這款新應用程式一開始接受度不高。
We took the bus to an uptown cafe. 我們搭公車去住宅區的一家咖啡店。
She lives in an uptown apartment. 她住在市區北部的一間公寓。
There has been a steady upward trend in the price of fuel recently.
The hikers followed the steep upward path to reach the mountain top.
The hot air balloon began to rise upward into the clear blue sky.
Please make sure you look upwards when you are climbing the ladder.
Uranium is used as fuel in some power plants. 鈾被一些發電廠用作燃料。
The mine contains a small amount of uranium. 這座礦場含有少量鈾。
The city is planning to improve its urban infrastructure system. 城市正計劃改善其城市基礎設施系統。
Modern urban life can be very exciting but also quite stressful. 現代城市生活可能非常刺激，但也相當充滿壓力。
Urbanization changed the shape of the town. 都市化改變了這個城鎮的樣貌。
Rapid urbanization can increase housing pressure. 快速都市化可能增加住房壓力。
I had a sudden urge to call my old friend and see how she was doing. 我突然有一種強烈渴望（衝動），想打電話給我的老朋友看看她過得怎麼樣。
The government urged people to stay at home during the heavy snowstorm. 政府敦促人們在暴風雪期間留在室內。
The doctor spoke with a sense of urgency regarding the patient's condition.
There is a growing sense of urgency about addressing climate change.
We need to take urgent action to address the problem of climate change. 我們需要採取緊急行動來應對氣候變遷問題。
He spoke in an urgent tone, telling us that we had to leave immediately. 他用急促的語氣說話，告訴我們必須立即離開。

meaning: 匆匆忙忙，帶著緊迫感，因為這非常重要。
sentences: We all urgently need to apply solutions to the problem of pollution. 我們都迫切需要採取解決污染問題的方法。
Funds are urgently required if this work is to be completed as planned. 如果這項工作要按計劃完成，急需資金。
The doctor checked his urinary tract. 醫師檢查了他的泌尿道。
She drank more water for urinary health. 她為了泌尿健康多喝水。
Our new puppy still urinates on the carpet, but we're housebreaking her. 我們的新小狗仍然在地毯上撒尿，但我們正在對她進行入室盜竊。
Boys on their campsite should avoid urinating within 200 feet of the lake. The word urinate is central here. 露營地的男孩應避免在距離湖 200 英尺的範圍內小便。排尿這個字是這裡的中心。
The nurse collected a urine sample. 護士收集了一份尿液樣本。
Dark urine can be a sign that you need more water. 尿液顏色深可能表示你需要多喝水。

meaning: 甕，缸，（煮茶或咖啡用的）大水壺
sentences: The ancient Greek urn was beautifully decorated with mythological scenes. 那個古希臘甕上裝飾著精美的神話場景。
The hotel provided a large silver urn filled with fresh coffee. 飯店提供了一個裝滿新鮮咖啡的大銀壺。
The old phone is still usable. 這支舊手機還能用。
Make sure the form is usable on small screens. 確認表單在小螢幕上也方便使用。
The dictionary provides examples of correct word usage in different contexts. 字典提供了不同語境下單字正確用法的範例。
The government is trying to reduce water usage during the summer months. 政府正試圖減少夏季期間的用水量。
Can I use your pen for a moment? Mine just ran out of ink. 我可以借用一下你的筆嗎？我的剛好沒水了。
The Internet is a powerful tool used for gathering information. 互聯網是用於蒐集資訊的強大工具。
He bought a used car after saving money for over a year. 存了一年多錢後，他買了一輛二手車。
This old laptop is used for simple tasks like writing and email. 這台舊筆電被用於處理寫作和郵件等簡單任務。
She gave me some very useful advice on how to save money. 她給了我一些關於如何省錢的非常實用的建議。
This new dictionary is extremely useful for language learners. 這本新字典對於語言學習者來說非常有用。
The usefulness of the tool became clear after one week. 一週後，這個工具的實用價值變得很明顯。
She questioned the usefulness of another meeting. 她質疑再開一次會是否有用。
This broken pen is useless. 這支壞掉的筆沒用了。
It is useless to worry without taking action. 只擔心卻不行動是沒有用的。
The new software was designed to provide a better user experience. 這款新軟體旨在提供更好的使用者體驗。
Users are required to enter their password to access the system. 使用者被要求輸入密碼以造訪系統。
The usher showed us to our seats in the large movie theater.
The new discovery helped to usher in a new era of scientific research.
I'll meet you at our usual spot near the park entrance at noon. 我們中午在公園門口的老地方碰面吧。
The commute to work took longer than usual due to the heavy rain. 由於大雨，上班通勤時間比平時長。
I usually wake up early and go for a quick run in the park. 我通常早起並去公園慢跑。
The traffic is usually very heavy during the morning rush hour. 早上尖峰時段交通通常非常擁堵。

meaning: 通常透過非法手段從他人手中奪取權力。
sentences: People often usurp when the situation calls for it. 當情勢需要時，人們常常會篡奪權力。
Learning when to usurp helps you communicate more clearly. 了解何時篡奪可以幫助您更清晰地溝通。
The kitchen was equipped with all the necessary utensils for cooking.
Ancient stone utensils were found during the archaeological excavation.
The doctor explained the uterine scan. 醫師解釋了子宮掃描結果。
Uterine health is important during pregnancy. 懷孕期間，子宮健康很重要。

meaning: 子宮。女性體內孕育胎兒的器官。
sentences: The fetus develops inside the uterus during pregnancy. 懷孕期間，胎兒會在子宮內發育。
The doctor used an ultrasound to examine the uterus. 醫生使用超音波檢查子宮。
The kitchen has a plain, utilitarian design. 這間廚房採用樸素實用的設計。
He chose a utilitarian backpack with many pockets. 他選了一個有很多口袋的實用背包。
The new software is designed for maximum utility and ease of use. 這款新軟體的設計旨在實現最大效用和易用性。
The monthly utility bills, such as water and electricity, are quite high. 每月的水電費（公共設施費用）相當高。
We should learn how to utilize new technologies effectively in our work. 我們應該學會如何在工作中有效地利用新技術。
The project aims to utilize renewable energy sources to protect the environment. 該專案旨在利用可再生能源來保護環境。

meaning: 最極端的；最偉大的、終極的。
sentences: the utmost assiduity 最大的勤奮
the utmost harmony 最大的和諧
The novel describes a peaceful utopia. 這本小說描述了一個和平的烏托邦。
A perfect city may sound like a utopia. 完美城市聽起來可能像理想世界。
His plan sounded utopian but difficult to achieve. 他的計畫聽起來很理想化，但難以實現。
The book imagines a utopian city. 這本書想像了一座烏托邦式城市。
The whole project turned out to be an utter failure and lost millions.
She couldn't utter a word after hearing the shocking news yesterday.

meaning: 完全地;完全;最大限度地。
sentences: Well, now we are utterly lost. 好吧，現在我們完全迷失了。
I have failed you utterly. 我徹底讓你失望了。
